selector_state.task: pick up the milk and place it in the basket

cached_visual_keyframe.summary: The robot is holding the milk carton and has moved it over the basket. The next step is to release the carton into the basket.
cached_visual_keyframe.visible_evidence: The external camera shows the gripper holding the milk carton directly above the open basket. The wrist camera confirms the carton is held securely.
cached_visual_keyframe.target_identity: The interior floor of the basket
cached_visual_keyframe.distractor_check: The target is the basket's interior, not the milk carton itself (which is already held) or the other items on the floor.
cached_visual_keyframe.completion_evidence: The milk carton is no longer held by the gripper and is visible inside the basket.
cached_visual_keyframe.risk: The carton might not be released cleanly if the gripper opens too slowly or if the position is slightly off-center.
cached_visual_keyframe.replan_condition: If the milk carton remains in the gripper after the release command or falls outside the basket.
